name: Kanazawa

queries.query: Kanazawa Japan official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS map city
queries.scope: Identify first-party local land-registry/cadastral sources and safe anonymous parcel geometry.
queries.result: Kanazawa’s official sources refer to cadastral-map and cadastral-register records, land-number reference maps, and the city open-data/map-information platform. Property-tax registers are available to owners and other legally eligible parties through documented application; the public map portal advertises facility maps and a map API but the reviewed catalogue did not expose a parcel-feature dataset or schema. No safe anonymous parcel-vector route or WUP-point geometry was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search followed by official-source review.
